description: This Java class extends IntentService to handle an action that resets a quiz by communicating with a connected device via Google's Wearable API. It manages connections, retrieves capabilities, and sends reset messages to appropriate nodes.

classes.name: QuizReportActionService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles resetting a quiz by communicating with connected wearable devices through Google's Wearable API.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles the incoming intent; initiates connection to GoogleApiClient and requests capability info to send reset message.

methods.name: sendResetMessage
methods.description: Sends a reset message to all connected nodes capable of resetting the quiz.
